source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1026 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1026 was established by Ordinance No. 31419, passed by the Dallas City Council on January 8, 2020. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1026 is established on property located along the west line of SE 14th Street south of Skyline Road. The size of PD 1026 is approximately 6.52 acres. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.104. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 1026A: development plan.

(2) Exhibit 1026B: landscape plan. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) For an electrical substation, development and use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 1026A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) For all other uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the R- 7.5(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district; etc.

(b) The following main use is permitted by right:

-- Electrical substation. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-7.5(A) Single Family District apply.

(b) Electrical substation.

(1) Minimum front yard is 15 feet.

(2) Minimum rear yard is 20 feet. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

Consult the use regulations in Division 51A-4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) For an electrical substation, landscaping must be provided as shown on the landscape plan (Exhibit 1026B). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(c) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.112. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Fences For An Electrical Substation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.113. FENCES FOR AN ELECTRICAL SUBSTATION.

(a) Fences located in a required front yard are limited to a maximum height of nine feet.

(b) Fence panels having less than 50 percent open surface area must be located more than five feet from the front lot line.

(c) Except as provided in this subsection, fence materials must comply with Section 51A-4.602(a)(9). Barbed wire and razor ribbon (concertina wire) are prohibited unless the barbed wire or razor ribbon (concertina wire) is six feet or more above grade and does not project beyond the Property line. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Lighting For An Electrical Substation
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.114. LIGHTING FOR AN ELECTRICAL SUBSTATION.

(a) Light poles may not exceed 18 feet in height.

(b) Light poles or light fixtures must be located a minimum of 25 feet from adjacent residential property lines.

(c) Exterior lighting must be directed away from adjacent properties.

(d) All light poles must be shielded fixtures. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.115. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 31419)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1026.116. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 31419)
